title: Prayer

about.heading: What is prayer?
points: You can pray anywhere, any time, out loud or quietly in your heart.
You can use your own words. You can say thank you, I'm sorry, I'm scared, or please help.
Prayer is listening too. Be still for a moment.

about.heading: Prayer is not
points: A test. You can't get it wrong.
Magic words or a wish. God always listens, and answers in his own way and time.
Only for church or for grown-ups.

closing: Many people end with "Amen." It means "let it be so."

prayers.title: My first prayer
prayers.text: God, I'm new at this. Thank you for listening to me. Help me get to know you. Amen.

prayers.title: Thank you
prayers.text: God, thank you for today. Thank you for my family, my friends and my teachers. Thank you for loving me. Amen.

prayers.title: Before class
prayers.text: God, thank you for my dojo. Help me listen, try my best and be kind to everyone on the mat. Amen.

prayers.title: When I'm scared
prayers.text: God, I feel scared. Please stay close to me. Help me be brave and remember I am not alone. Amen.

prayers.title: I'm sorry
prayers.text: God, I'm sorry for what I did wrong. Please forgive me. Help me make it right and do better. Amen.

prayers.title: For someone else
prayers.text: God, please be with my friend. Help them and let them know they are loved. Amen.

prayers.title: Bedtime
prayers.text: God, thank you for this day. Watch over me and my family tonight. Give us good rest. Amen.

prayers.title: The Lord's Prayer
prayers.source: Matthew 6:9-13, King James Version, word for word. WAITS FOR JAY: he asked for the Lord's Prayer (Nov 25) but has not yet said which wording Action Zone uses.
prayers.text: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
